d: Expansive river constellation meandering from near Orion to far southern star Achernar, rich in nearby exoplanet hosts.

hip-7588.x: Extremely oblate, fast-rotating blue-white star (139 ly) terminating the celestial river.
hip-7588.t: Alpha Eridani · End of the River

gaia-5164707970261890560.x: Nearby young solar analogue (10.5 ly) with planet AEgir and multiple dusty debris belts, benchmark for planetary evolution.

gaia-3195919528989223040.x: Nearby triple system (16.3 ly) containing the first recognized and most easily viewed white dwarf companion (40 Eri B).

gaia-4847957293278177024.x: Nearby G8V solar analogue (19.7 ly) hosting multiple confirmed low-mass exoplanets.

gaia-3211922645854328832.x: Blue-white giant star marking the northern headwaters of the celestial river near Rigel.

gaia-5111187420714898304.x: Red giant pulsating variable star shining warmly along the middle course of the river.
